# update

Update an existing Dataverse relationship

## Usage

```
ppds relationship update [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--cascade-assign` |  | `CascadeBehavior?` |  | Updated cascade behavior for assign |
| `--cascade-delete` |  | `CascadeBehavior?` |  | Updated cascade behavior for delete |
| `--cascade-merge` |  | `CascadeBehavior?` |  | Updated cascade behavior for merge |
| `--cascade-reparent` |  | `CascadeBehavior?` |  | Updated cascade behavior for reparent |
| `--cascade-share` |  | `CascadeBehavior?` |  | Updated cascade behavior for share |
| `--cascade-unshare` |  | `CascadeBehavior?` |  | Updated cascade behavior for unshare |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--dry-run` |  | `bool` |  | Validate only, do not persist changes |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--name` |  | `string` |  | Schema name of the relationship to update |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--solution` | `-s` | `string` |  | Solution unique name containing the relationship |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
